subject: MOG archive directory-entry contract
authority: Original Windows x86 plus the supplied PBAIMOG.VSR. Record field names are inferred; widths, offsets and transfers are evidenced. Mac tagChunkInfo/tagCHUNK names support runtime naming, not serialized layout.

reproduce.implementation: Execute original and rebuilt GetChunkInfo, InputDword, vsRead and vsSeek. Model only CRT fread/fseek/ftell from archive bytes. Resolve current addresses through reccmp/PDB; check the existing original executable hash. No matching-score changes.

fields.meaning: kind; DIRC numeric value 0x44495243 in observed containers
container extent excluding the first 8 bytes, as observed in this archive

container_header.metadata: Bytes after the header and before the entry table form the directory metadata block. Entry metadata offsets address this block in file coordinates.
container_header.validation_limit: Original CMogDir constructor discards the first two DWORDs and asserts the version. The fixture reader's container, range and cycle checks do not describe original validation behavior.

serialized_entry.byte_order: Five little-endian 32-bit words, then 16 unchanged name bytes.

fields.meaning: fixed name bytes; parser adds no terminator

serialized_entry.name_limit: All names in the supplied archive contain a null byte. This does not establish a general guarantee or text encoding.
serialized_entry.directory_size_limit: Twenty DIRC entries declare zero payload size but point to nonempty child containers. Original GetNextDir follows the file offset without a size-nonzero guard.

native_entry_parser.seek: low32((iterator.index+1)*36 + directoryTableOffset), absolute origin 0. The first entry uses iterator.index=-1.
native_entry_parser.initialization: Clear next.info (+0x18), child.info (+0x20), directory (+0x24). Keep next.index (+0x14) and child.index (+0x1c) untouched.
native_entry_parser.metadata_pointer: runtime metadata base + low32(serialized metadata offset - directory metadata file start), stored at node+0.
native_entry_parser.field_mapping: ID -> node+8; kind -> node+4; file offset -> node+12; size -> node+16; name bytes -> node+40. Disk and runtime field orders differ.
native_entry_parser.transfers: One seek; five separate four-byte reads; one 16-byte read. InputDword reads into a stack local. This body ignores read counts and adds no bounds or overflow checks.
native_entry_parser.abi: ECX receiver, one pointer argument, RET 4. Node pointers and class offsets belong to the original 32-bit Windows runtime.

checks: Decoded runtime fields and complete untouched heap match an independent fixed-width record model.
Original/rebuilt file operations and heap writes agree in order, values and destinations. Internal stack destinations are normalized; stack placement is not a port contract.
Next/child index fields retain their initial poison bytes.
Callee-saved registers and one-argument stack cleanup are preserved.

limits_and_next_work: Valid supplied archive, disjoint objects and modeled CRT success. No short-read/error, allocator, recursive-constructor or full-game equivalence claim.
Fixture input guards establish safe test inputs; they do not retrofit validation into the original parser.
A separate port needs fixed serialized widths independent of host unsigned long and pointer sizes. Do not read disk bytes directly into the runtime node.
Next resource work: arena ownership, cache lock/release, allocation and read failures, then representative resource payload decoders.
